current_page_main_arc: Page 7 presents the core findings on ChatGPT's explanation quality through Figure 3, establishing two key metrics: answer-explanation concordance and Density of Insight (DOI). The page transitions from accuracy analysis (covered on page 6) to evaluating whether AI-generated explanations contain educationally valuable insights. The main narrative establishes that 88.9% of ChatGPT responses contained at least one significant insight, and that high-quality outputs are characterized by DOI>0.6, with accurate answers showing significantly higher DOI than inaccurate ones.

continuity_resolutions.from_page_6: Page 6 established ChatGPT's accuracy rates and introduced the section 'Explanations generated by ChatGPT contain nonobvious insights.' Page 7 continues this thread by presenting the actual insight frequency data and DOI metrics. The adjudicator methodology mentioned at the top of page 7 (second-year student for Step 1, fourth-year for Step 2CK, PGY-1 for Step 3) completes the sentence that begins at the bottom of page 6.
continuity_resolutions.to_page_8: Page 7 ends mid-sentence discussing DOI thresholds (DOI>0.6 for high quality outputs). Page 8 completes this thought by defining low quality outputs (DOI≤0.2) and presenting the statistical comparison (0.458 vs 0.199, p<0.0001). Page 8 then transitions into the Discussion section, so page 7 represents the final results presentation before interpretation begins.
